CustomField.description: Only used when Strategy__c is RandomizeByPattern. When checked, every character matching ReplacementPattern__c is randomized. When unchecked, only ReplacementCharacterCount__c of the matching characters (counting from the end of the value) are randomized, leaving the rest of the real value untouched.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to randomize every matching character. Leave unchecked to randomize only the last ReplacementCharacterCount__c matching characters. Only applies when Strategy is Randomize By Pattern.
CustomField.label: Redact
